name: web/SQLi error-based PostgreSQL-family
description: [high] Proves error-based SQLi (PostgreSQL family): posts a broken quote; dialect-specific driver errors (psycopg PG::, org.postgresql, SQLSTATE 42, unterminated string) in the response = server-side SQL interpretation. Keywords: sqli error-based postgresql exception syntax. ctrl: benign POST shows no driver error -> not falsified. probe_url = JSON endpoint echoing 'email' into SQL.

conditions.pattern: (?:org\.postgresql\.util\.PSQLException|PG::(?:SyntaxError|InvalidTextRepresentation)|SQLSTATE\[42|unterminated quoted string at or near|syntax error at or near)
